=== references to symbols in their own section, by binding
        .set    noreorder
        .text
        .globl  glob, hid, prot, intl, galias, func
        .hidden hid
        .protected prot
        .internal intl
        .weak   weak1, walias, whid
        .hidden whid
        .type   func, %function
        .hidden lhid
start:
        bal loc
        bal glob
        bal weak1
        bal hid
        bal prot
        bal intl
        bal whid
        bal lhid
        bal func
        bal late
        bal lweak
        bal lalias
        bal lwalias
        bal galias
        bal walias
        b loc
        b glob
        b weak1
        b lalias
        b walias
        beq $4, $5, loc
        beq $4, $5, glob
        beq $4, $5, weak1
        beq $4, $5, lalias
        beq $4, $5, walias
        nop
loc:    nop
glob:   nop
weak1:  nop
hid:    nop
prot:   nop
intl:   nop
whid:   nop
lhid:   nop
func:   nop
late:   nop
lweak:  nop
        .globl  late
        .weak   lweak
        .set    lalias, glob
        .set    lwalias, weak1
        .set    galias, loc
        .set    walias, loc

=== references back to symbols in their own section
        .set    noreorder
        .text
        .globl  glob
        .weak   weak1
loc:    nop
glob:   nop
weak1:  nop
        .set    lalias, glob
        bal loc
        bal glob
        bal weak1
        bal lalias
        b loc
        b glob
        b weak1
        beq $4, $5, loc
        beq $4, $5, glob
        beq $4, $5, weak1

=== references out of their section, by binding
        .set    noreorder
        .text
        .globl  oglob
        .weak   oweak, uweak
        .set    oalias, oloc
        bal oloc
        bal oglob
        bal oweak
        bal oalias
        bal ext
        bal uweak
        nop
        .section .text.other,"ax"
oloc:   nop
oglob:  nop
oweak:  nop

=== data referring to symbols, by binding
        .set    noreorder
        .data
        .globl  glob, galias, hid
        .weak   weak1, walias
        .weak   uweak
        .hidden hid
        .set    lalias, glob
        .set    lwalias, weak1
        .set    galias, loc
        .set    walias, loc
base:   .long   loc, glob, weak1, hid, lalias, lwalias, galias, walias, ext
        .long   loc - ., glob - ., weak1 - ., lalias - ., walias - .
        .long   glob - base, weak1 - base, base - weak1, lalias - base, walias - base
        .long   ext - ., uweak - .
loc:    .long   0
glob:   .long   0
weak1:  .long   0
hid:    .long   0

=== default section alignment
        .set    noreorder
        .text
        .byte   1
        .data
        .byte   2
        .section .rodata
        .byte   3
        .bss
        .space  1
        .section .text.hot,"ax"
        .byte   4
        .section .data.rel,"aw"
        .byte   5
        .section .init,"ax"
        .byte   6
        .section custom,"a"
        .byte   7
